title: emacs-jabber-i386 → devel
diff:
diff --git a/ubuntu-release b/ubuntu-release
index 70553b8..7fee912 100644
--- a/ubuntu-release
+++ b/ubuntu-release
@@ -89,3 +89,18 @@ force-skiptest livecd-rootfs/26.10.15
 # possibly regress s390x-only. all other arch's already passed tests.
 force-skiptest ibus/1.5.34-1ubuntu3
 force-skiptest gnome-shell/51.0-2ubuntu2
+
+# changed from arch all to any and not built on i386 (lp: #2168912)
+force-badtest emacs-jabber/0.13.1-1/i386
+
+# librust-tree-sitter-*-dev:i386 is not installable (partial i386 arch).
+# Debian dropped skip-not-installable from debian/tests/control, turning the
+# previous skip into a failure.
+force-badtest tree-sitter-bash/0.25.1-3/i386
+force-badtest tree-sitter-go/0.25.0+ds-2/i386
+force-badtest tree-sitter-ini/1.4.0-3/i386
+force-badtest tree-sitter-json/0.24.8-3/i386
+force-badtest tree-sitter-php/0.24.2-2/i386
+force-badtest tree-sitter-powershell/0.25.10-3/i386
+force-badtest tree-sitter-verilog/1.0.3-4/i386
+force-badtest tree-sitter-yaml/0.7.2-3/i386
